question.text: Under the AIF Regulations, uninvested funds pending deployment may be invested in:

answer.text: Liquid mutual funds, bank deposits, or other liquid high-quality assets

explanation.text: The Logic: Un-invested investable funds and divestment proceeds pending distribution may be invested in liquid mutual funds, bank deposits, Treasury bills, Triparty Repo Dealing and Settlement, commercial papers, certificates of deposit, or similar higher-quality liquid assets until deployment or distribution. The Trap: These are interim parking options pending deployment or distribution — not investment destinations. The fund must eventually deploy in line with its stated investment objective. Note: The list is per the workbook's treatment of uninvested investable funds.
